other_failure_modes.name: Arbitrary prediction flipping based on validation AUC
other_failure_modes.description: The agent inverts the final test predictions (1.0 - pred) if the validation AUC is less than 0.5. Since the validation set is just a small sample, an AUC slightly below 0.5 could easily occur due to natural variance alone; flipping the predictions in this scenario would incorrectly and severely degrade true test performance.

summary: The agent successfully implements a LightGBM pipeline with robust feature engineering (TF-IDF, frequency encoding, missing value handling) and a safe prediction fallback mechanism. However, it applies stateful feature transformations on the entire training set prior to the train/validation split, leading to moderate data leakage. Additionally, the agent includes a critical logical flaw where it flips final test predictions if the validation AUC drops below 0.5, which is highly sensitive to variance and could catastrophically ruin performance.
